## Staleness: rolling-window models scored on later days

Training duration: 3 days; 2-seed mean-logit ensemble. Row counts and traffic mix vary across windows, so age is not isolated from training volume or cohort effects. AUC is across logged impressions, not within-opportunity ranking. No uncertainty intervals or equivalence test are computed for these trends.
